$comment: Module registry. Source of truth for plan frontmatter `module:` (validated by `pnpm plans:lint`). status: reference = canonical pattern to imitate; active = exists, follows the pattern; planned = does not exist yet (a plan may create it). `cross-cutting` covers work that spans apps/packages without belonging to one business module.

modules.name: employees
modules.summary: Colaboradores: alta, desvinculación, directorio. Full reference: aggregate with rules, command, query, port to another module.

modules.name: organization
modules.summary: Empresas del holding. Exposes OrganizationApi to other modules.

modules.name: identity
modules.summary: Usuarios, login y sesiones opacas (ADR 0011); RBAC y contexto de request.

modules.name: attendance
modules.summary: Marcaciones, turnos, jornadas, horas extra. Legal requirements apply. Today: device registry and raw marcaciones from ZKTeco ADMS. Punches attributed by RFC.

modules.name: payroll
modules.summary: Remuneraciones / liquidaciones. Money math: always min_implementer mid+.

modules.name: platform
modules.summary: Cross-cutting: shared packages, API shared kernel/infrastructure, tooling, infra, harness.
